Cusco · Perú

Puka Pukara

A walled lookout on the approach to Cusco

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

This terraced complex stands beside the old approach to Cusco. From below, the walls seem stacked; from the upper platform the road and valley explain the importance of the position. The modern name refers to a red fortress, not conclusive evidence of a single military purpose.

Planning your visit

30–45 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

A walled lookout on the approach to Cusco

Keep the lower course of the wall in the foreground and the road corridor behind it. The photograph then explains the position of the site as well as its colour.

History and local experience

The approach road is part of what you are visiting. A position with broad views could oversee movement between the surrounding highlands and Cusco.

Walking route

  1. Puka Pukara, carretera Cusco–Pisac
  2. Begin below the outer wall, climb by the signed visitor stair and stop at the upper terrace to look back along the approach.
  3. Use the stair again for the descent.

Before you go
